children: Overview
Germany digital solutions provider's preliminary H1 pro-forma total output rose 26% yr/yr to about €106 mln
Pro-forma adjusted operating EBITDA grew 68% yr/yr to about €32 mln
Company raised FY26 outlook for organic EBITDA, total output and recurring revenue growth
Outlook
Chapters Group raises 2026 organic EBITDA growth outlook to high-thirties percent range
Company now expects 2026 organic growth in total output and recurring revenue in low-teens
Outlook for Public Sector & Enterprise segment organic revenue growth remains at high single digits
Result Drivers
AI AND AUTOMATION - Co said deployment of AI and automation, along with organizational simplification, contributed to improved performance across the group
FINANCIAL TECHNOLOGIES SEGMENT - Strong performance in Financial Technologies, driven by merger synergies and improved customer offering, was a key growth driver
END MARKET DEMAND - Co said strong end market demand supported performance, especially in Financial Technologies
